displayName: Pray Reminder — Prayer Times & Ramadan Countdown
description: Prayer time reminders and a Ramadan countdown in the status bar & sidebar, so you never miss a prayer while coding. No runtime dependencies, works offline.
view.title: Prayer Times
config.language: Display language for the status bar, notifications and dashboard.
config.language.auto: Follow the IDE display language (Indonesian if the IDE is in Indonesian, otherwise English)
config.method.kemenag: Ministry of Religious Affairs, Indonesia (Fajr 20°, Isha 18°)
config.method.makkah: Umm al-Qura, Makkah (18.5° / Isha 90 minutes after Maghrib)
config.ihtiyat: Safety margin (minutes) added to every prayer time. Kemenag uses 2 minutes.
config.imsakMinutes: Imsak = this many minutes before Fajr.
config.remindBeforeMinutes: Send a reminder this many minutes before each prayer time. 0 = disabled.
config.modalNotification: Show the prayer time notification as a modal dialog (must be clicked) so it can't be missed.
config.hijriOffset: Shift Ramadan dates (days) relative to the Umm al-Qura calendar, e.g. 1 if your country starts a day later.
config.showRamadanCountdown: Show the Ramadan countdown in the status bar and dashboard.
